name: security-gcp-storage-object-acls-review
intent: Cloud Storage effective publication across IAM, ACL and bucket modes
artifacts: Bucket access mode, IAM, applicable object ACLs, public-access prevention and specific object intent.
trace: Resolve the effective access path for one principal/object and distinguish object retrieval, listing and modification under the configured bucket mode.
experiment: Use owned public/private synthetic objects and compare anonymous and intended principal operations at known paths.
disproof: A public bucket label or metadata alone is not disclosure of a confidential object; disabled ACL paths must not be treated as effective grants.
repair: Align publication mode and effective grants, verifying intentional public content and private-object denial.
branch_decisions: Branch on uniform bucket-level access: enabled UBLA disables ACL grants. With UBLA disabled, applicable IAM and ACL grants act in parallel; checking only one can miss an allow. Resolve inherited public-access prevention (PAP): it blocks allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers grants but does not revoke signed URLs authorized through their signer. Such a URL succeeding is not a PAP bypass; review issuer entitlement separately. A stale public ACL alone proves no current exposure. Compare direct anonymous access, entitled identity access and any separately authorized signed capability.
